checks.description: The newest run of each workflow at its tip, by the runners the repository names, when `commits` was asked.

main.description: A repository's branches, the default first and the rest by name, a page at a time: follow `cursor` until it is absent. No authentication needed; asked as an account, with a service token or the pages' session cookie, a private repository it is a member of is read too, and the answer is that account's alone.

errors.description: No such repository, revision, path or record.
errors.name: NotFound

commits.description: Each branch's tip commit and its checks too, as a page of branches shows them, rather than its name alone, as a menu of them does.

cursor.description: How many branches the pages before held.

repo.description: The repository's dev.knotless.repo record. Its authority may be a handle; a name the repository had before, or an owner it moved from with its agreement, finds it under the name it has now.
